title: Loading frames and bogie handling for a Type IV cylinder-liner annealing oven
summary: The wheeled frame holding workpieces and the bogie carrying that frame into the oven perform different handling tasks. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s Type IV cylinder-liner annealing proposal dated 5 September 2022 positions polymer liners in a frame cart, then transfers and secures it on a bogie for horizontal furnace entry. Confirm workpiece location, both support interfaces and hot-air passages together; chamber dimensions alone cannot select the frame.
